note: Planned implementation requirements. Fresh diagnostic results are separately documented; no product completion implied.

cases.condition: Every required positive-evidence field changed independently with valid recomputed receipt ID/hash
cases.required_behavior: Refuse forged semantic evidence; test all18 fields, not only stale hashes.

cases.condition: Genuine AAPL confirmation, no-lineage, pre-lineage, as-reported and latest-restated
cases.required_behavior: Retain correct values, immutable source hashes and historical refusals; no invented revision.

cases.condition: Same-report duplicates with different decimals; precision-compatible nontransitive chain
cases.required_behavior: Keep source occurrences and distinguish exact/consistent/inconsistent; no greedy transitive equality.

cases.condition: Ordinary comparative reprint vs amendment vs changed reported fact
cases.required_behavior: Confirmation is not revision; latest_restated remains missing without explicit revision evidence.

cases.condition: Three or more accession lineage with contradiction or ambiguity
cases.required_behavior: Version and review multi-filing law; preserve v1 refusal instead of disabling its guard.

cases.condition: Currency, units, scaling, fiscal and calendar periods differ
cases.required_behavior: Refuse incompatible comparisons or expose an explicitly governed conversion and basis.

cases.condition: Known dimensions, empty dimensions and unknown dimensions
cases.required_behavior: Do not treat unknown as consolidated; dimensional lineage does not confer metric eligibility.

cases.condition: Derived ratio with zero/missing/negative or mismatched denominator
cases.required_behavior: Version formula/applicability; print missing/not-applicable reason, never invented zero.

cases.condition: Repeated visual rows, rowspan tables and instant cash inside duration columns
cases.required_behavior: Preserve statement presentation and semantic period separately; no accidental duplicate loss.

cases.condition: Inline transforms, hidden values, taxonomy changes and malformed source package
cases.required_behavior: Retain parse evidence and explicit unsupported states; independent validator is not mapping authority.

cases.condition: Invented or unsupported namespace URI with plausible concept/value
cases.required_behavior: Reject; preserve approved original taxonomy identity, not a guessed namespace.

cases.condition: Later filing, correction, mapping or rule available after query cutoff
cases.required_behavior: Exclude from then-known view under each required source/system/policy clock.

cases.condition: Historical filing fetched today without historic capture evidence
cases.required_behavior: Label reconstruction; never mint historical operational attestation.

cases.condition: CIK, security aliases and multiple share classes
cases.required_behavior: Use Data OS owner binding; no new identity namespace or double-counted issuer.

cases.condition: Production provider unavailable or invalid
cases.required_behavior: No silent synthetic/golden fallback; retain separate demonstration delivery labels.

cases.condition: Unsupported issuer/accession/metric/query size
cases.required_behavior: Return bounded typed refusal; no arbitrary source fetch or misleading empty success.

cases.condition: Incomplete package, digest mismatch, stale manifest or correction
cases.required_behavior: Do not publish a complete generation until required components verify.

cases.condition: Write response lost, immediate absence or delayed commit
cases.required_behavior: Preserve original-target EFFECT_UNKNOWN; no replay/failover until reconciliation.

cases.condition: Untrusted source markup, XML expansion, scripts, unexpected redirects or huge input
cases.required_behavior: Bound parser resources, sanitize display, deny execution and unsafe source traversal.

cases.condition: Many operators request SEC sources concurrently
cases.required_behavior: Use one incumbent shared request budget; no10-per-worker multiplication or limit evasion.

cases.condition: No new filings, source outage, duplicate delivery and retry
cases.required_behavior: Differentiate checked-no-change from source_outage and stale; idempotent generation, no rerender freshness.

cases.condition: Signed-out, unauthorized or wrong-entitlement request
cases.required_behavior: Deny before opening private provider; no secret/source body in error or logging.

cases.condition: Different users or temporal query policies hit shared cache
cases.required_behavior: Tenant/entitlement/policy/generation isolation; saved research does not alter canonical facts.

cases.condition: Public shell, source drawer, browser bundle and network errors
cases.required_behavior: Do not leak locked licensed content or private receipts; authorized source trace works.

cases.condition: Model candidate contains invented figure or injected instruction
cases.required_behavior: Deterministic evidence admission rejects; narrative never creates canonical number or action authority.

cases.condition: Large percentage move from tiny base or basis change
cases.required_behavior: Expose amount/base/period, source and materiality rationale; no opaque universal risk score.

cases.condition: Accounting anomaly with legitimate alternative explanation
cases.required_behavior: Label observation/inference and uncertainty; never assert fraud or alpha without supporting evidence.

cases.condition: Missing disclosure vs failed extraction vs moved/rephrased section
cases.required_behavior: Distinguish source absence from process failure; do not invent removed disclosure.

cases.condition: KPI definition changes; revenue/ARR/guide/consensus; GAAP vs non-GAAP
cases.required_behavior: Retain issuer definition/version and reconciliation; do not splice unlike histories.

cases.condition: Bank/financial-institution statement or denominator
cases.required_behavior: No industrial gross-margin/FCF detector leakage; print applicability and sector-native basis.

cases.condition: Industrial company financing subsidiary and eliminations
cases.required_behavior: Distinguish group/segment/consolidated scope; no inventory or cash-flow double-counting.

cases.condition: Alphabet multiple securities with one filing issuer
cases.required_behavior: One issuer filing truth, supported security projection, no duplicate peer weight.

cases.condition: Four additional accounting stress issuers
cases.required_behavior: Same general provider and kernel with governed packs; no ticker-specific patched answers.

cases.condition: Twelve specialist packs with different quality/coverage
cases.required_behavior: Each pack gets its own schema/gold/held-out/review/live proof; group summary cannot hide gaps.

cases.condition: Peers with misaligned periods, missing scope or incompatible metrics
cases.required_behavior: Explicit exclusions and denominators, comparability controls and no synthetic ranks from missing data.

cases.condition: 250-deep/1000-core coverage targets
cases.required_behavior: Predeclare issuer/period/field thresholds; prove them by manifest, not ticker loop count.

cases.condition: Previously unseen issuer/report format or negative example
cases.required_behavior: Untouched held-out tests, false-positive/abstention report and failed-family disposition.

cases.condition: Same query in Python/kernel/API/UI/CSV/Parquet/JSON
cases.required_behavior: Identical normalized value, cutoff, basis and provenance; serialization differences explicit.

cases.condition: Source-linked Excel formula, refresh, signed-out state and correction
cases.required_behavior: Real supported Excel environment demonstration; static workbook does not satisfy refresh.

cases.condition: CSV/Excel formula injection, precise decimals, dates and null values
cases.required_behavior: Safe cell encoding and exact numerical/vintage roundtrip; no hidden numeric-to-string ambiguity.

cases.condition: Reload/direct link/back navigation of saved query or alert
cases.required_behavior: Restore exact subject/metric/period/policy/cutoff/cohort; reuse existing user-state/notification owners.

cases.condition: Primary analyst asks what changed and why it matters
cases.required_behavior: Readable first viewport and drilldown; do not bury insight in a dense database wall.

cases.condition: EN/ZH desktop/tablet/mobile and keyboard use
cases.required_behavior: Readable responsive layout, focus restore, no clipping and correct disabled/unavailable text.

cases.condition: Evidence source click from number, change or finding
cases.required_behavior: Resolve to relevant authorized source span and occurrence/version, not a generic home page.

cases.condition: Newly admitted real filing through installed production path
cases.required_behavior: Source/capture/query/publication/browser linkage and natural-cycle proof; no fixture-only acceptance.

cases.condition: Predeclared load/network/corpus benchmark and slow owner
cases.required_behavior: Meet accepted latency SLOs with measured distributions; no request-time SEC and no silent stale-green.

cases.condition: Restart, lost publication, restore and rollback
cases.required_behavior: Exact generation/receipt recovery, tenant protection, originals intact; no duplicate writers.

cases.condition: Finding outcome learned later or corrected after publication
cases.required_behavior: Preserve original judgment/version; delayed evidence does not rewrite past apparent knowledge.

cases.condition: Native Opus to Fabric operator to worker execution
cases.required_behavior: Actual supported/admitted starts and consumed returns; one global envelope, no simulated fleet.

cases.condition: Pressure to finish excluded adjacent programs
cases.required_behavior: No SNI/Grey Deer Risk/Market OS/Options/Prophet/Market Ontology/GMI/Executive/Fabric implementation; excluded legacy work recorded, not marked done.

cases.condition: Phase, research report or CI is green but product obligations remain
cases.required_behavior: No premature finalization; clear included-scope acceptance and remaining natural/human/effect obligations.

cases.condition: Unverified rights, licence renewal or attestation trust change
cases.required_behavior: No purchase/credential/permission bypass; block only dependent release and continue safe independent work.

cases.condition: Historical query after a mapping/rule revision
cases.required_behavior: Return the cutoff-valid policy version; no newest-rules hindsight contamination.

cases.condition: Async export resumes after entitlement/cancellation or source change
cases.required_behavior: Use existing job/export owner; immutable input refs and reauthorization; no second lifecycle.
